title: Remove older unmarked paqad agent files on re-onboard?
context: Older projects have paqad agent files in their .claude/agents folder that carry no paqad mark (today's generated files start with '---'). When they re-onboard, should paqad remove those too? Without a mark paqad can only spot its own old files by name and content. Removing them leaves one copy of each stage agent; leaving them means stages may run twice. A file the Developer changed by hand is kept either way and named in the output.
